title: The opposing informational effects of AI trading
abstract: arXiv:2611.18872v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Better artificial intelligence (AI) can improve individual forecasts without making prices better at revealing new information. In a competitive market with resource-constrained forecasting, more capable algorithms can substitute analysis of public records for private observations, reducing the private information aggregated into prices. The same trades can convey sophisticated public-data analysis to investors unable to perform it themselves. We establish conditions under which these effects coexist and the private benefit of further computation falls. Numerical equilibrium calculations and finite-data neural-market experiments exhibit corresponding patterns. Out-of-sample earnings forecasts and controlled language-model tasks show related patterns of information substitution. translated_abstract: 更好的人工智能（AI）可以改善个体的预测，但不一定使价格能更好地揭示新信息。在预测资源受限的竞争市场中，更强大的算法可以用对公开记录的分析替代私人观察，从而减少被聚合到价格中的私人信息。与此同时，同样的交易可以将复杂的公开数据分析传递给那些自身无法完成此类分析的投资者。我们确立了这些效应共存以及进一步计算的私人收益下降的条件。数值均衡计算和有限数据的神经网络市场实验呈现出相应的模式。样本外盈利预测以及受控的语言模型任务也显示出类似的信息替代模式。在神经网络实验中，AI的更广泛采用增加了价格对有限观察者的预测价值，降低了价格对高级观察者的预测价值，并降低了（进一步计算的收益）……
tldr: 更强大的AI交易通过用公开数据分析替代私人观察来提升个体预测能力，但这反而减少了价格中聚合的私人信息，其信息效应对不同能力水平的投资者呈现相反的方向。
en_tdlr: More capable AI trading improves individual forecasts by substituting public-data analysis for private observations, thereby reducing the private information aggregated into prices, with opposing informational effects for sophisticated versus limited observers.
